title: Level Select
description: Neon level picker with 3D cards, a parallax starfield and a sliding retro grid.
steps: `itemAnimation` spaces cards by `itemSize`, drops neighbors 18 pt and scales them to 0.78; each card turns ±35° from its `relativeProgress`.
`defaultIndex={5}` opens on the newest level, and `onSnapToItem` flips `autoplayDirection` at either end.
Three star layers and the floor grid slide by `progress` × 10, 25, 45 and 60 for depth.
